name: Light Torch
description: Touch a torch to a lit campfire until it catches.

crit_success.message: Catches instantly, burning bright and even. (The lit state is a state write the task-703 executor performs; craft resolves no fuel here.)

success.message: The torch takes the flame. (Torch lit — state write belongs to the task-703 executor.)

fail.message: Smoke but no flame — torch unlit, time lost, nothing spent.

crit_fail.message: Fumbled into the mud — torch kept but unlit and filthy.
